name: net_session_browser_dialog_refresh_session_list
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::RefreshSessionList refreshes the DirectPlay session list box from enumerated sessions, formats each row, records the source session index as item data, and selects the first row when there was no previous selection. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The focused smoke covers the no-prior-selection populate path. Prior-selection restoration and empty-list modem-gated disable behavior remain covered by Binary Ninja/source review but not by this smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b150 validates EnumSessions storage to m_sessionCount, LB_GETCURSEL, optional CListBox::GetText, LB_RESETCONTENT, per-session current/max player count lookup, session name lookup, zLoc::FormatMessage with max 120 and message 0x112, LB_ADDSTRING, LB_SETITEMDATA, prior-selection restore via LB_FINDSTRINGEXACT, default first-row selection when there was no prior selection, modem-gated OK disable for empty results, and return of m_sessionCount.

The native smoke patches EnumSessions, SendMessageA, and zLoc::FormatMessage, then verifies list reset, two formatted rows, item-data session indices, default first-row selection, m_sessionCount, and return count for the no-prior-selection path.
